title: Urth mob prototype
description: One mob prototype: data/world/<area>/mobs/<vnum>.yaml. Anything left out is filled from the level baseline by the rules' mobBaseline hook.

name.description: Short description used in sentences: a city guard.

description.description: Room listing line: A city guard stands here. Defaults to '<Name> is here.'

flags.description: sentinel never moves; roam may wander out of its area; peaceful cannot be attacked; questmaster hands out quests (docs/RULES.md 7.6). Others are free for rules.

health.description: Overrides the derived maximum when positive.

attack.description: Natural attack used when nothing is wielded.

armor.description: Natural defense used when nothing is worn.

xp.description: Overrides the kill reward when positive.

sells.description: What this quest vendor exchanges for quest points (docs/RULES.md 7.6). A mob flagged questmaster gives quests out.
